comment: Frozen legacy references for tools/architecture/ownership-guard.py: per file and category, the approved source lines. The list only shrinks: a cleanup deletes its lines here in the same change (a vanished line is an error), a new reference is never approved by editing this file, and a new shared file gets no entry. 'ownership-guard.py --strict --freeze' rewrites the lines of existing entries (never their reasons). User-facing prose string literals are not policy and need no entry.

app/ui/bb_disc.c.reason: chd reader for the library probe uses the vendored libchdr header (transitional, moves with the PS1 adapter)

platform/3ds/bb_platform.c.reason: generated arena size header (build/systems), a build product not a system policy

app/ui/breadbox_arena.c.reason: generated arena size header (build/systems), a build product not a system policy

app/ui/config.c.reason: shared config still carries PS1 core override keys (audit step 3 splits app config from system state); shared config still stores the PS1 last-game state name (audit step 3 splits app config from system state)

app/ui/covers.c.reason: cover fetch reads disc lists from the PS1 library entry (audit step 3)

ps1-content-type: static bool fetch_cover(const game_t *g, bool *retry, cover_t *c)
static bool load_cover(const game_t *g, bool *retry, bool refresh, cover_t *c, bool *fresh)
static bool upgrade_cover(const game_t *g, bool *retry, cover_t *c)

app/ui/devcontrol.c.reason: developer remote reports PS1 core options and picks library entries (dev tool, audit step 3); dev remote reads the PS1 state folder for state import/export (moves with the PS1 adapter, step 3)

app/ui/gpu_cache.c.reason: PS1 renderer glue: direct gpu_pica header (platform split, audit step 2/3)

app/ui/home.c.reason: Continue still resolves the PS1 library entry (audit step 3; room line owns this file); home resume logic still tracks the PS1 last-game state name (typed resume ref is audit step 3)

app/ui/main.c.reason: launch path, PS1 memory map and BIOS dir creation (audit step 3; room line owns this file); startup creates the PS1 state folder (PS1 adapter init owns it after step 3)

app/ui/pmu.c.reason: PMU stats read the PS1 gpu thread option and frameskip header

include/breadbox/library.h.reason: split from psx3d.h: mixed legacy header: game_t, BIOS dir and libretro glue (audit step 2 splits it); PSX3D_STATE_DIR path macro and last_game_state config field live in the umbrella header until step 3
